title: Who does it, and where meaning changes
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: who does the work (roles, the people, teams, partners and agents who fill them, and the rights each one has), and domains: parts of the organisation with their own customers and words, where meaning changes at the edge, and what crosses it is translated.
howto: Paper notes on a wall are drafts; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model. Yellow is the business layer, where actors and roles live; blue is the network's domain, rose is retail's. Cyan outlines the technical side, gold the business side.
